top_signals.title: Judge denies WhatsApp’s bid to hold spyware maker in contempt for allegedly targeting users
top_signals.summary: WhatsApp argued that NSO Group violated a 2025 injunction against using the messaging app to spread spyware. A federal judge said WhatsApp hurt its case by not revealing enough information.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
